meta.title: 🐞 Fix tree performance: only render children when parent is expanded
meta.body_summary: Copilot fixed tree component performance by conditionally rendering children only when parent is expanded, claiming drastic reduction in DOM nodes for large datasets.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added ngIf wrapper to tree children rendering; no formal review, closed by maintainer after ~18h with no human comments despite e2e test failures.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 14 changed lines in a single file, this is a minimal edit by absolute volume. It fits a tiny performance PR that could be merged quickly, but closure suggests either incomplete fix or missing maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or human comments provided. The only interaction is from automated bots reporting CI results and bundle size increase.
review_details.performance_claim: Tree component now only renders children when parent is expanded, reducing DOM nodes from 3000 to 3-10 for large datasets.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer without merge; CI e2e tests had failures but no explicit feedback; no human comment on performance or correctness.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A minimal Angular template change with a strong narrative performance claim but lacking benchmarks or automated profiling; the PR was closed without merge, possibly due to insufficient evidence or maintainer decision.

detection_detail.code_reading: No code-reading review in dataset; maintainer closed PR without comment.
detection_detail.ci_auto: CI e2e tests ran with some failures, but no performance-specific validation.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body claims 'Before: 3000 rendered, After: 3-10', but no before/after metric or benchmark artifact; no profiling data or load test.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge after 18h; no fix-in-PR cycle despite CI e2e failures.

core_change_summary.description: In tree.template.html, wrapped the *ngFor child rendering block with <ng-container *ngIf="!item || item.isExpanded"> to prevent rendering of collapsed tree children.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only template file changed; no TypeScript logic modifications.
change_trajectory: Single commit: added ngIf wrapper around child tui-tree elements; 8 lines added, 6 lines removed.
